concerns.text: The cited NIST JSONL dataset (<https://huggingface.co/datasets/nisten/opus5-5-doctor-patient-conversations-all-human-diseases/resolve/main/opus5-5diseaseconversations.jsonl>) is a collection of doctor‑patient conversation texts, not engineering or fatigue‑related data. Using it as “Additional engineering data (no stress)” is inappropriate for the domain and undermines the validity of pipeline verification.

The UCI CSV link (<https://huggingface.co/datasets/udayl/UCI_HAR/resolve/main/csv_files/test.csv>) points to a Human Activity Recognition dataset, which contains generic numeric features unrelated to manufacturing processes, material properties, or fatigue life. This dataset does not serve the intended purpose of “process‑only data (pipeline validation)”.
